text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Time feels slower than when we're training... but before you know it, night has already fallen, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Would you like some tea before bed?
It's chamomile."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You brewed this for me, Ruby?
Thank you, I'd love some.
...Ah, but I'm not really good with tea etiquette...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I believe it's best to simply take your time and enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm good at that sort of thing.
Thank you, Ruby.

It seemed K.S.Miracle
was able to spend
a very relaxing day off.
